learned: 2026-10-05, by an agent pass: 101 products over six category pages (flower 26, pre-roll 21, infused pre-roll 16, kief ground flower 20, vape 12, edibles 6). NY-only brand (OCM-PROC-24-000095).
notes: Webflow CMS. /products shows one grid that stops at 100 items (it missed /products/cap-junkie, a 3.5g flower), so the recipe reads the six /category/<slug> pages instead, each well under the cap. A new category on the site (sitemap.xml lists them under /category/) needs adding to urls.

Each card: fs-list-field=category is the site's format (Flower, Pre-roll, Infused pre-roll, Kief infused ground-flower, Vape, Edibles), h2 the bare strain or flavour, and a nested fs-list-field=size one size (14g, 3.5g, 0.5g, 1g, 0.7g, 2g, 100mg). Pack counts are only in the h2 ('Blue Dream 10 Pack', 'Wedding Mintz 2 PK').

Pack sizes are set from the packaging renders on the cards, because the card size is per pre-roll and the reader takes '1g' beside '10 Pack' as the total: the 10-pack bag says '10 one gram prerolls, NET WT. 10G'; 'The Infused Pack' says 'Five 0.7 gram pre-rolls, 3.5 grams'; 'The Six Pack' image is named '.5g Pre-roll 6 Pack' and its page says six pre-rolls.

The infused 2-packs' cards say 0.7g, but that field was copied from the singles (the Green Crack 2 Pack page even carries Green Goblin's kief text). The Green Crack 2-pack tube reads 48.1% and THC/PKG 721.5MG, which is a 1.5g package, and NY stores list all eight 2-packs at 1.5g. So 2-packs are set to 2pk 1.5g.

Edible pages say 'Each package contains 10 easily separable 10mg portions (100mg total)', so every 100mg gummy is 10pk 100mg. 2g vapes are 'All-In-One Disposable' on their pages; the 1g vapes are carts (the Skywalker OG COA is 'Revert Cartridge Skywalker OG 1g').

Kief infused ground-flower is flower with subtype preground, the subtype taxonomy.token_subtype gives a store's 'Kief Infused Ground Flower'. 'Homie Pack - <STRAIN>' is the same 14g ground flower sold with papers; Homie Pack is the line. Infused pre-rolls carry no line: the brand names none beyond 'Infused', and no strain is sold both infused and plain.
